scripts.android:generate-key: mkdir -p android/app/keystore && keytool -genkeypair -v -keystore android/app/keystore/my-release-key.jks -keyalg RSA -keysize 2048 -validity 10000 -alias my-key-alias -storepass mypassword -keypass mypassword -dname 'CN=Invidious TV, OU=Dev, O=MyCompany, L=City, S=State, C=US'
scripts.android:build: npx cap build android --keystorepath android/app/keystore/my-release-key.jks --keystorepass mypassword --keystorealias my-key-alias --keystorealiaspass mypassword --androidreleasetype APK || echo 'DONE'
